_comment: Summary templates, read by BOTH summarize.py and the app
(app/Sources/SummaryTemplates.swift). One file so the two can never
disagree about what 'Standup' means - the section list used to live inline
in summarize.py AND again in Transcript.swift, so any change had to be made
twice or the app silently failed to parse its own output.
Each section carries its heading in English and Hebrew. The summary is
written in the language of the transcript, so the heading has to follow it;
`guidance` is what the model is told the section should contain.
User-defined templates live in Application Support and merge on top.

templates.name: Standard
templates.description: A general meeting record: what it was about, what was decided, who owes what.

sections.guidance: 2-4 sentences describing what the meeting was about
decisions that were actually reached
tasks, with the owner's name where it was said

templates.description: A manager and a report: how things are going, feedback both ways, what happens next.

sections.guidance: what was discussed, in 2-4 sentences
feedback given or received, in either direction
career, skills or goals raised
what each person committed to

templates.name: Standup
templates.description: Yesterday, today, blockers. Short by design.

sections.guidance: work reported as completed, grouped by person
what each person plans to work on
anything reported as blocked, and on whom

templates.name: Interview
templates.description: A candidate conversation, written so it can be compared against other candidates.

sections.guidance: background and experience as the candidate described it
evidence of strength, with the example that showed it
gaps or doubts raised, without inventing any
only the recommendation actually voiced in the conversation

templates.name: Client call
templates.description: What the client asked for, what was promised, and what is due.

sections.guidance: why the call happened and where things stand
requirements and requests, in the client's own terms
what was promised, by whom, and by when if stated
agreed next steps

templates.name: Lecture
templates.description: A talk or class, kept as study notes rather than minutes.

sections.guidance: the subject and the argument, in 2-4 sentences
the main points, in the order they were made
terms introduced, each with the definition given
questions asked, with the answer if one was given

templates.name: Session
templates.description: A working or coaching session: themes, insights, what to carry forward.

sections.guidance: what the session covered, in 2-4 sentences
recurring themes across the session
realisations or conclusions reached during the session
what was left to continue with

templates.name: Consultation
templates.description: An advisory conversation: the situation, the read on it, the advice.

sections.guidance: the situation as it was presented
how it was assessed, and on what grounds
the advice given
agreed next steps

templates.name: Investor meeting
templates.description: An investor conversation: numbers discussed, doubts raised, what was asked for.

sections.guidance: what the meeting covered, in 2-4 sentences
figures quoted, exactly as stated and never rounded or invented
objections, risks or doubts the investor raised
what either side asked for or committed to
material to send and next steps
